name: What is the best type of insulation for a steel building?
description: Fiberglass blankets with vapor barriers are common and cost-effective, while rigid board and spray foam offer superior air sealing and higher thermal resistance

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of insulation for a steel building?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiberglass blanket insulation with a reinforced vapor retarder is the standard choice for pre-engineered steel buildings, though rigid board and spray foam are also common alternatives. A major practical tradeoff comes down to cost versus thermal performance. Traditional fiberglass rolls draped over purlins during frame erection are the most budget-friendly option. However, rigid foam or spray foam provides continuous thermal breaks and better air sealing at framing joints, which prevents condensation issues inside conditioned workshops or commercial storage structures.
